scope: local synthetic Docker; shared workstation; no cloud or production claim
comparison: sequential Boot 3.5.16 pre-migration JARs vs Boot 4.0.8 qualified JARs; fresh PostgreSQL/Kafka/Redis volumes per variant
java: Temurin 21 JRE (same runtime Dockerfile/base for both variants; image IDs captured separately)

load.workload: POST /api/v1/orders through JWT gateway; unique Idempotency-Key; synthetic quantity 0.001; HTTP 201 assertion
load.token: new synthetic JWT per phase; never saved in evidence

analysis.percentiles: nearest rank per run, median across run percentiles
analysis.errors: failed JMeter success flag OR responseCode !=201; weighted across runs
limits: rate limited workload, not maximum throughput
shorter than historical 600s/1200s protocol; do not compare historical p99 directly
